title: Coverage Continuity Reduction on Immunization Services Cash Doses
content:
# Patient Care Desk Guidance — Coverage Continuity Reduction (Immunization Services)

The coverage continuity reduction on the charge for a cash-paid Immunization Services dose is **20 percent** where the insurance plan the course is billed to ended, by its termination date, 60 days ago or less and an earlier dose of the course was billed to a plan; **10 percent** where that plan ended more than 60 and no more than 365 days ago and an earlier dose was billed to a plan; and nothing otherwise.

## What the desk reads

- **The insurance plan the course is billed to** is the coverage record named on the vaccination course, one of the patient's plans held under **Prescription Insurance on File**.
- **When it ended** is read from that coverage record's termination date. The days since it ended are the calendar days from the termination date to today; a termination date of today counts as 0 days ago. A plan with no termination date, or with a termination date still in the future, has not ended.
- **An earlier dose of the course billed to a plan** is a dose entry on the course billed to an insurance plan through the pharmacy benefit.

## Condition and result

| Plan the course is billed to ended | Earlier dose billed to a plan | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| 0 to 60 days ago, both ends included | Yes | 20 percent |
| 61 to 365 days ago, both ends included | Yes | 10 percent |
| More than 365 days ago | Yes | Nothing |
| Not ended (no termination date, or a date after today) | Yes | Nothing |
| Any | No | Nothing |

## Boundary days (hypothetical dates)

- Plan ended exactly 60 days ago, an earlier dose billed to it: **20 percent**. Ended 61 days ago: **10 percent**.
- Plan ended exactly 365 days ago, an earlier dose billed to a plan: **10 percent**. Ended 366 days ago: **nothing**.
- Plan ended 30 days ago, but every earlier dose of the course was paid in cash: **nothing**.
